text:
alex: Quick UX question — for per-route console views, should the default saved preset be 'latency-first' or 'cost-first' when a model is pinned? We had a support case where a webhook client suddenly saw cost spike.

mira: Definitely worth debating. My instinct: latency-first for interactive/API routes, cost-first for embeddings/batch. Also we should show an explicit cost delta in the preset picker so people aren't surprised. :thinking_face:

jason: Technically, our current endpoint returns the UI preset from /routes/:id/view as `preset: \"latency\"` (server default). Changing that is a breaking behavior for some customers who cache views. We can add a non-breaking fallback: new query param `ui_preset=auto` and a header `X-Default-Preset: auto` to let new clients opt in. Example: `GET /api/routes/123/view?ui_preset=auto`.

kevin: If we flip defaults we also need telemetry. Please ensure `route_view_preset` and `preset_source` tags are emitted so we can attribute cost regressions. Right now sampling doesn't include the preset name.

mira: UX idea: in the presets dropdown show small badges: `Latency (est. +0.02ms, +$0.10/10k)` — tooltip with how we calculate estimate. That should reduce surprise.

alex: +1 on the badge. For rollout, can we canary by route traffic class? e.g., 10% of routes default to cost-first for a week and monitor unit cost?

jason: We can route by tag on server side (route.metadata.traffic_class). Implementation plan: add `preset_policy` to route config (enum: fixed|auto|policy) and a routing policy service to return the computed preset. Non-breaking because if not present we keep existing `latency`.

sara: FYI we already have a live ticket from Acme where they saved a view and got charged extra — they complained that console default hid the cost preview. This is blocking our SLO to reduce surprise.

kevin: Ops: add a histogram for token-cost-per-request bucketed by `route_view_preset` and `model_variant`. We need to compare pre/post.

mira: Actionable list: 1) design mock with badge + tooltip (I'll put in Figma). 2) API spec PR (jason) adding `ui_preset=auto` and `preset_policy` in route config. 3) telemetry events update (kevin). 4) roll out canary for 10% routes and add alert: cost increase >15% -> automatic rollback.

jason: I'll open the API PR today with a migration note. Proposed response shape: `{"preset":"latency","preset_source":"server-default|route-config|user-choice"}` so clients can show provenance.

alex: Love that. Can we also include an example client snippet in the PR for the JS SDK? `const view = await client.getRouteView(123, { ui_preset: 'auto' })`

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-07-12 02:00 UTC — will include telemetry changes for route_view_preset.

mira: Thanks — I'll file the savedview default policy doc and tag eng/design. We should aim for a 2-week canary and a postmort check on cost telemetry.

alex: Sounds good. If anyone objects to the plan ping me. :thumbsup:
